name: ownerrez
description: Use OwnerRez in ChatGPT to read and manage your vacation-rental account: bookings, guests, properties, quotes, payments and messages, plus API and support documentation.

interface.longDescription: Connect your own OwnerRez account through OAuth to work with vacation rentals in ChatGPT. Ask for this week's arrivals, check a booking's balance, or find a guest and their bookings. You can also look up OwnerRez API and support guidance, then make supported account changes such as adding a booking tag. ChatGPT may ask you to confirm a change before it's sent to your account. To limit ChatGPT to reading, choose Read-only when you connect, or later in OwnerRez under Settings > Connected Apps, where a change applies right away.
defaultPrompt: Show my arrivals this week and any guests with an open balance

positive.description: This week's check-ins and check-outs by property (published example prompt)
positive.prompt: What check-ins and check-outs do I have this week, by property?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's properties, then this week's arriving and departing bookings grouped by property, with dates in each property's timezone and blocked dates left out.

positive.description: Upcoming bookings that still owe money
positive.prompt: Which bookings arriving in the next 14 days still have a balance owed?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists bookings arriving in the next 14 days that still have an amount owed, with each booking's guest, dates and balance.

positive.description: Find a guest and their bookings
positive.prompt: Find guest Whitlock and show me their bookings.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the guest by name, then shows the guest and their bookings with property, dates and balance.

positive.description: Inquiries and quotes that have not become bookings (published example prompt)
positive.prompt: Do I have any inquiries or quotes that haven't turned into bookings yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads /v2/inquiries and /v2/quotes and lists the ones that have not become bookings, with guest name, property and dates.

positive.description: Add a tag to the next upcoming booking
positive.prompt: Add a tag called VIP to my next upcoming booking.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next upcoming booking and describes the change. ChatGPT may show its permission card first, depending on the plugin's Permission setting. Then api_write sends POST /v2/tags and api_get on /v2/tags for that booking shows VIP. If an earlier run already tagged the booking, the API refuses the duplicate with "Tag may not be used more than once."

negative.description: Refuse data outside the connected account
negative.expected_behavior: Booking 1 is not in the demo account. The tool answers that it found nothing for that request on this account, and ChatGPT shows no booking data.

negative.description: Refuse a write on a read-only connection
negative.prompt: Add a tag called VIP to my next upcoming booking.
negative.expected_behavior: Setup: in OwnerRez, open Settings > Connected Apps, set ChatGPT's access to Read-only. api_write refuses before sending anything and says the connection is read-only and the booking is unchanged.

negative.prompt: Charge the guest's card ending 4242 for $500.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines. No tool accepts card numbers, and the OwnerRez API v2 has no endpoint that charges a card.

publication.release_notes: Connecting now asks OwnerRez for read and write access, so the OwnerRez authorization page offers View and make changes, preselected, or View only.
